entries.title: Versioned text-to-avatar serving pipeline
entries.summary: At the audited main revision, the Python Engine resolves the question, retrieves reviewed persona evidence, supplies a persona profile and source context to a configured language model, and returns answer text with citation metadata and a behavior plan. The web application can send committed answer sentences to a configured voice service and play audio while rendering the avatar. A source citation indicates a selected record; the code does not equate citation presence with factual entailment.

entries.title: Committed corpus versus locally exported interviews
entries.summary: The audited default Jensen corpus contains 32 reviewed editorial evidence records from nine publisher sources. The workbench can additionally export reviewed original interview question-answer exchanges into a separate local corpus. The number of records loaded in a teammate's demo depends on that local export; the repository alone does not establish its exact count. Retrieval supplies evidence during inference and does not train the LLM weights.

entries.title: Configurable local dialogue model
entries.summary: The local demo adapter defaults to an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint at localhost port 8103 and allows an explicitly configured external LLM endpoint. The launcher runs mlx_lm.server with locally registered model files; the selected model identity comes from the local runtime metadata. The adapter adds source-bound persona-card observations and conditional decision notes, with bounded response length. This configuration does not establish that Qwen outperforms other models or prove the team's selection rationale.

entries.title: Separate reference-conditioned voice synthesis
entries.summary: The local launcher configures a separate Qwen voice service with a reviewed reference WAV and its matching transcript. It checks the reference file hashes before starting. External voice endpoints are configurable. Voice reference conditioning is distinct from fine-tuning speech-model weights, and source code does not establish Jensen voice similarity or a measured speed on the presentation machine.

entries.title: Committed-sentence audio playback
entries.summary: The live endpoint generates text and queues committed complete sentences for synthesis. In this path the voice service returns a complete WAV for each sentence; the application then emits bounded PCM chunks for playback. This overlaps subsequent text generation with earlier speech work. It is application-level early playback, not proof of native token-input neural TTS. Server timing fields are distinct from browser playback timing and physical sound from the speakers.

entries.title: Configured appearance and gesture assets
entries.summary: The studio documentation separates the Gaussian face bundle, a body or rig, and optional learned gesture bundles. Gaussian face data supplies appearance, FLAME data and recorded expression coefficients; gesture data is selected separately. Private asset files and explicit runtime switches are required. The presence of a renderer or a learned-preview switch is not a measured result for facial likeness, natural gesture quality or semantic expression accuracy.

entries.title: Evidence export and multimodal alignment limits
entries.summary: The audited workbench exports reviewed text exchanges and source metadata to the dialogue corpus. Speech-reference preparation and visual assets have separate inputs and review records. These serving and export paths do not establish that every text passage has a jointly validated matching audio segment and visible speaking-face segment. Describe MCCCD-style utterance alignment as an intended collection approach unless the exact aligned dataset and its review record are supplied.

entries.title: Quality and latency measurement boundaries
entries.summary: The project distinguishes server request timing from browser playback and audible-output latency. Its documented benchmark harness can run real local LLM, speech and application processes with pinned assets. Results from one CPU or cached run do not establish latency on a teammate's Mac or at the venue. The answer should cite an actual run record before reporting any numeric speed improvement or voice-quality gain.

entries.title: Persona graph branch status at audit
entries.summary: At the 2026-11-21 audit, PR #29 was open and unmerged into main. Its opt-in experimental branch adds conditional persona-value and delivery guidance, not a newly trained character model. The saved small Qwen experiment did not show a net gain in strict advice quality, so the feature remains off by default. Do not claim a positive accuracy improvement, a merged feature, or automatic use by a separate Sophon realtime session.

entries.title: Separate realtime and upper-body branch status
entries.summary: At the 2026-11-21 audit, PR #27 for EMAGE gesture and upper-body Gaussian work was open and unmerged into main. That branch also contains a separate Sophon realtime conversation path. A feature added to the main Python text/RAG Engine is not automatically active in Sophon's own dialogue model. The running checkout, installed private assets and selected provider determine which path a demo uses.
